{{Quote|A storm is coming.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''The skies are clear, Tronda.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''So say your eyes. My bones say different.|Tronda and Numa's mother|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" />|translated=1}}
'''Tronda''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who the [[Numa's father/Legends|father]] of the [[Gender/Legends|girl]] [[Numa/Legends|Numa]] knew for her foresight. While at the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Tronda warned Numa's [[Numa's mother/Legends|mother]] about a storm they had foreseen through their [[Skeleton/Legends|bones]], inspiring the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] to clear out the shelter in her [[Numa's home/Legends|residence]]. Shortly after, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded the planet, during which Numa's father and mother were [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|How was the market, love?''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''The usual, though Tronda says a storm is coming.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''Tronda, always seeing things.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''Still, it would be good to get the shelter cleared.|Numa's father and mother|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" />|translated=1}}
Tronda was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who spent [[Time/Legends|time]] in<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" /> the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]]<ref name="TLAotH">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|120}} [[The Clone Wars: Curfew|''The Clone Wars: Curfew'']] dates itself to just prior to the events of the episode.</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Clone Wars">{{CSWECite|I|131|Clone Wars}}</ref> The Twi'lek was an acquaintance of the [[Numa's mother/Legends|mother]] of<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" /> the young [[Gender/Legends|girl]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|numa|Numa}}</ref> [[Numa/Legends|Numa]] and was known to<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" /> her<ref name="DB" /> [[Numa's father/Legends|father]] to be always seeing things. While at a market in Nabat, Tronda told the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] that they sensed a storm was coming, though the mother saw that the skies above were clear. Tronda responded back that their [[Skeleton/Legends|bones]] said different from the mother's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" />

After the mother returned to their [[Numa's home/Legends|residence]], Numa's father asked them how the market was. The mother told the man that it was the usual, but that Tronda had sensed a storm. The father said that the Twi'lek was always sensing things, but the mother thought it would be good to get their shelter cleared.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" /> The Confederacy, led by the Separatist [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], invaded Ryloth not long after.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> Numa's mother and father were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during it.<ref name="DB" />

==Personality and traits==
Tronda was a pale-skinned Twi'lek with [[Color/Legends|brown]] eyes and cone-shaped [[Ear/Legends|ears]],<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" /> a sexually dimorphic trait found mostly on female Twi'leks.<ref name="Cones">{{InsiderCite|115|Ask Lobot}}</ref> The Twi'lek said to Numa's mother that they saw through their bones a storm was incoming, and Numa's father viewed them as always sensing things.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" />

==Equipment==
While at the Nabat market, the Twi'lek wore a brown [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] with a purple collar and a gray oval brooch. Tronda also wore purple wrappings around their [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] and carried a purple bag.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tronda was introduced in ''[[The Clone Wars: Curfew]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] part of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic series]]. The comic was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], illustrated by [[Katie Cook]], and published on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="The Clone Wars: Curfew" /> on [[March 9]], [[2009]].<ref name="Release Date">{{Rebelscum|url=story/front/Jedi_Journals_Online_Comic_Curfew_121605.asp|text=Jedi Journals: Online Comic - Curfew|author=Jay|date=2009-03-09}}</ref>
